name: llmwiki-bridge
description: Guided skills for connecting Codex to existing LLMWiki, Markdown, or Obsidian knowledge through llmwiki-serve.

interface.longDescription: LLMWiki Bridge provides setup, status, and doctor skills for connecting Codex to existing LLMWiki, Markdown, or Obsidian knowledge through llmwiki-serve. It starts with direct source connections and suggests llmwiki-agent-bridge only when multi-source or runtime-backed synthesis is needed.
defaultPrompt: Use the llmwiki-bridge:setup skill to connect ./wiki safely.
Use the llmwiki-bridge:status skill to inspect running llmwiki-serve sources without restarting them.
Use the llmwiki-bridge:doctor skill to run a read-only readiness check.
